superoptimizer.gui.title: SuperOptimizer
superoptimizer.gui.subtitle: Safe performance settings for 26.4
superoptimizer.desc.enabled: Fully disables the optimizer and background tasks. Useful for clean comparisons and conflict diagnosis.
superoptimizer.desc.entity: Skips submitting some fully hidden entities. Uncertain visibility always renders.
superoptimizer.desc.block_entity: Conservatively culls only a safe vanilla Block Entity allow-list. Disabled by default for compatibility.
superoptimizer.desc.pause_motion: Temporarily disables culling during significant camera movement to avoid false pop-out.
superoptimizer.desc.workers: Background CPU threads for independent tasks such as shaderpack scanning. The render thread is never moved here.
superoptimizer.desc.reserved: Leaves CPU cores free for Minecraft, the OS and other applications.
superoptimizer.desc.iris_lock: If Iris is detected, SuperOptimizer culling is disabled to avoid shader-pass conflicts.
superoptimizer.desc.entity_culling_lock: If the separate Entity Culling mod is installed, SuperOptimizer does not run a second culling system.
superoptimizer.desc.diagnostics: Keeps diagnostic events in the SuperOptimizer log viewer.
superoptimizer.desc.file_logging: Also writes the ring-buffer log to config/superoptimizer.log.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_scan_async: Scans shaderpacks in the background so the UI stays responsive.
superoptimizer.desc.save: Save the current configuration to config/superoptimizer.properties.
superoptimizer.desc.apply_return: Apply the profile and return to the previous screen.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.microwave: Minimal load: entity culling only, no Block Entity culling, one background worker and extra CPU reserve.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.light: Light mode for normal play: entity culling and cautious background work.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.balanced: Main mode: entity + safe-list Block Entity culling, Iris protection and camera-motion pause.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.advanced: Advanced mode with a larger CPU budget for independent background tasks. Renderer and shaderpack code are not rewritten.
superoptimizer.logs.title: SuperOptimizer Logs
superoptimizer.shaders.title: Shader Library
superoptimizer.shaders.iris_detected: Iris detected. Iris is not auto-enabled on Vulkan; ZIP packs can be stored here and selected through a compatible shader loader.
superoptimizer.shaders.iris_missing: Iris not found. SuperOptimizer can store/import ZIP packs but is not itself a shader loader.
